extension.summary: Play NTS Radio live streams and Infinite Mixtapes
extension.description: Listen to NTS 1, NTS 2, and the 16 NTS Infinite Mixtapes directly in Kodi. No account or API key required — streams play directly from NTS's public CDN URLs.
extension.news: 1.0.1 - Fix now-playing/visualisation screen showing the default album art instead of the NTS logo. 1.0.0 - Initial release: NTS 1, NTS 2, and Infinite Mixtapes.
